description_short.value: Ghanaian bank in the pan-African Ecobank group, offering retail, corporate and investment banking.
description_short.source: Written by us from the Ecobank Ghana PLC summary financial statements for 2024 (GSE PR 095/2025, general information note)

description_full.value: Ecobank Ghana PLC and its subsidiaries provide retail, corporate and investment banking and other financial services in Ghana. The bank is part of the pan-African Ecobank group: Ecobank Transnational Incorporated, the group's parent, holds 68.93% of its shares. Its registered office is at 2 Morocco Lane, off Independence Avenue, in Accra, and its shares have been listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange since July 2006. Impairment charges of GHS 1.7 billion pushed it to a small loss in 2022, and it paid no dividend for 2022 or 2023. It returned to profit in 2023, and profit after tax rose to GHS 1.7 billion in 2024, when it resumed dividends.
